Contract CoCoMESystem::closeCashDesk(cashDeskID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = cashDeskID),
		currentStore: Store = CurrentStore,
		cashDesks: Set(CashDesk) = currentStore.AssociationCashdeskes->select(o|o.IsOpened = true)
	precondition:
		currentStore.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		cashDesks.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		let closedCashDesk: CashDesk in
		closedCashDesk = cashDesks->any(o|o.Id = cashDeskID) and
		closedCashDesk.IsOpened = false
}
